title: DiceKeys recipe
description: The fields Packages/Derivation reads, and the two the app writes (`purpose`, `#`), from a recipe that is a JSON object; a recipe may also be the empty string. Any other field is salt: it is hashed with the rest of the text and never read. The reference DiceKeys format is the subset without separator and capitalize that names only the two lists dated 2020. recipe-format.md has the rules a schema cannot express.

type.description: Must equal the type being derived.

algorithm.description: Keys only: XSalsa20Poly1305 for SymmetricKey, X25519 for UnsealingKey, Ed25519 for SigningKey. An error on Password and Secret.

lengthInBytes.description: Secret: 1 to 8160, default 32. Keys: 32. Password: any integer, then overridden by the word count. The bounds are Secret's; a validator rejects values that Password ignores.

lengthInChars.description: Password only. Truncates the finished password. On a character-set list, given alone, it is instead the number of characters derived, 1 to 1020.

lengthInBits.description: Password only. Default 128. The resolved word count must not exceed 1020.

lengthInWords.description: Password only. Given with lengthInBits, it must equal the fewest words whose combinations reach 2^lengthInBits.

wordList.description: Password only. Lists dated 2020 are the reference's; the rest are this app's.

separator.description: Password only; on a character set only the empty string is allowed. This app's extension. Present, the password has no count prefix and its words are joined by this; `digits` puts one derived digit between words. Absent, the reference joining.

capitalize.description: Password only, with separator. One whole word uppercased.

purpose.description: The recipe's label. Written by the app, not read by Derivation.

#.description: The sequence number. Written by the app when above 1, not read by Derivation.
